name: Trigenys Commerce Factory
tagline: Turn social conversations into discoverable, branded storefronts without creating a separate deployment for every merchant.
problem: Small merchants already sell through WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook, but scattered product photos, unclear availability and manual order conversations make discovery and catalog maintenance difficult. They need a lightweight shared storefront and a working merchant workspace before complex marketplaces or payment automation.
scenario: A merchant signs in, adds a product with variants, chooses a storefront presentation, publishes the catalog and shares a shop link. A buyer browses without an account, submits a request and agrees directly with the seller on WhatsApp; a WhatsApp click alone is never counted as a completed sale.
differentiation: One multi-tenant application separates public storefronts, authenticated merchant operations and a server-side tenant-aware API. It prioritizes fast catalog-to-conversation handoff, explicit merchant-confirmed payments and controlled infrastructure provisioned through AppFactory.
architecture: Browser React/Vite storefront and merchant workspace -> authenticated Cloudflare Worker API -> scoped store membership checks -> Neon PostgreSQL and private R2 media. Cloudflare Pages serves a shared frontend; AppFactory coordinates deployment using GitHub OIDC without committing provider credentials.
limitations: A beta storefront is not a hosted payment processor, inventory accounting suite or automatic order fulfillment service. Meta catalog synchronization, custom domains, campaigns and online payments are deferred; customer requests and WhatsApp clicks must not be mistaken for paid sales.

capabilities.name: Merchant and buyer journeys
capabilities.description: Implement storefront browsing, persistent cart, merchant onboarding and order-request flows with role-aware views.

capabilities.name: Merchant workspace
capabilities.description: Provide responsive workspace navigation, catalog and settings actions with documented accessibility checks.

capabilities.name: Store theme library
capabilities.description: Develop shared storefront presentations and theme customization without one deployment per merchant.

capabilities.name: Meta channel expansion
capabilities.description: Evaluate explicit consent, connector and webhook boundaries before enabling external catalog synchronization.

roadmap.name: End-to-end beta verification
roadmap.exitCriteria: Reviewed staging and production evidence for published shops, tenant isolation, role restrictions and buyer request recovery.

roadmap.name: Merchant trials and pricing
roadmap.exitCriteria: Run documented real merchant pilots, capture feedback and publish approved FCFA pricing and plan entitlements before paid onboarding.

roadmap.name: Optional Meta integration
roadmap.exitCriteria: Complete connector threat model, consent flow and webhook validation before enabling catalog sync.

references.name: Commerce Factory architecture decision
references.relevance: Shared tenancy, server access and storefront routing decision.

references.name: AppFactory README contract
references.relevance: Reusable, evidence-based documentation contract and presentation audit.

presentation.headline: A storefront for every merchant. One reliable platform.
presentation.summary: Transform scattered social sales into branded catalogs, practical merchant workflows and buyer conversations — without pretending a WhatsApp click is a paid order.
